notes.title: Update Notes for December 20
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued feedback and support! We've been working hard to address your suggestions and improve the gameplay experience.

---

Main Updates
[olist]
 Main Screen Speed: Slowed down the main screen transitions for a smoother user experience.
 Death Screen Timer: Increased the death screen duration from 3 seconds to 5 seconds to give players more time.
[/olist]

---

Level-Specific Changes

Umm Alsibyan
[olist]
 Camera Bug: Fixed a bug where the camera would clip into houses.
 Sign Arrows: Added arrows pointing to the first sign and the first checkpoint for improved navigation.
 Voice Volume: Increased Umm Alsibyan’s voice to make it more audible.
 Sign Placement: Adjusted the locations of signs to reduce spam interactions when placing objects.
[/olist]

Bu Duryah
[olist]
 Dashing After Water: Removed the ability to dash after jumping out of water. This change enhances the challenge and balance of the level by removing the previous single "bugged dash."
 Shark Health: Sharks now have 1 health point, making them easier to defeat.
 Water Voice: Lowered the volume of water sounds and limited the number of objects that trigger the sound.
 Barrel Physics: Fixed the weird falling behavior of barrels.
[/olist]

Napping Donkey
[olist]
 First Puzzle: Added a message to make the first puzzle easier to solve.
 Climbing Challenge: Improved the climbing mechanics for a smoother experience.
[/olist]

Umm Alduwais
[olist]
 Bird Size: Increased the size of birds to make landing on them easier.
 Kill Zone Bug: Resolved an issue where players would lose multiple lives in kill zones by adding insta-kill zones for clarity and consistency.
[/olist]

---

General Improvements
[olist]
 Interaction Buttons: Changed the "Chat & Pickup" button to `E` for easier reach.
 Respawn Boxes: Ensured dropped boxes respawn in water levels.
 Main Menu Mini-Game: Optimized the mini-game in the main menu and made it optional.
 Sound Controls: Added a new option for players to adjust sound levels and control audio settings.
[/olist]

---

We hope these updates enhance your experience! Keep sharing your thoughts and stay tuned for more improvements. 💡

notes.title: Update Notes for November 13
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued feedback and support! Here are the latest updates and improvements:

Boss Levels:
[olist]
 The timer now stops during conversations in boss levels, so you can take your time reading without the pressure of a countdown.
[/olist]
Umm Alduwais:
[olist]
 Added gameplay tips to help clarify objectives, as some players found the gameplay a bit confusing.
 Fixed a bug where lives could go into negative values.
 Updated the sleep bar icon to better reflect its status, clearly showing when it’s full, and when the player wins.
[/olist]
General Improvements:
[olist]
 Added Emirati Arabic voice-over to signs, similar to the existing voice-over for regular conversations.
 Conversation audio now stops when moving away from characters, creating a more seamless experience.
[/olist]

Keep sharing your thoughts, and stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Update Notes for Nov 10
notes.content:
Thank you for all your feedback and support! I've made several updates to improve the gameplay experience based on your input:

Umm Alduwais:
[olist]
 Limited the number of birds that can spawn at any given time to avoid overwhelming players.
 Reduced the bird spawn rate slightly.
 Added a new dialogue for when players lose due to not defeating birds quickly enough, giving clearer feedback on the reason for defeat.
[/olist]
The Tale of Greed:
[olist]
 Adjusted the whales to be less challenging.
 Increased the speed of boats for a smoother experience.
 Sharks are now pushed back when hit, adding a bit more control during encounters.
 Reduced the number of coins available in the level for a balanced challenge.
[/olist]
The Napping Donkey
[olist]
 Fixed a rendering issue where some rocks would disappear unexpectedly.
[/olist]
Overall Edits
[olist]
 Your falcon now collect stars, but not all of them.
 Game sounds are now muted when pausing the game.
 Fixed the boss level cards, which now correctly display without showing coin counts.
[/olist]

Keep sharing your thoughts, and stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Update Notes for Nov 5
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has tried the game and shared your feedback! Your comments and support mean a lot to me, and I’m excited to keep improving the game with your help. Here are the latest updates based on your feedback:

[olist]
 Improved Spin Hitbox – I've adjusted the hitbox for the spin move, making it easier to land attacks accurately.
 Bu Duryah Level Progression Fix – Fixed an issue in Bu Duryah level where players were sometimes not advanced to the next level upon completion. This should now work smoothly.
 Sea Level Skip Fix – A workaround that allowed players to skip the sea level has been addressed. Apologies if this removes a fun trick, but I’m keeping the adventure challenging!
[/olist]
Keep sharing your thoughts, and stay tuned for more updates!
